filter.chip-hint: Search this field only: the text typed in the search bar becomes its filter
filter.chip-selected-hint: Remove this filter, or replace its value with the text typed in the search bar
filter.favorites-empty-hint: Save the current search (its text and filters) to reopen it here in one click.
filter.filters-applied: {0} No filter|{1} :count filter applied|[2,*] :count filters applied
filter.filters-empty-hint: Filters narrow the results. Pick an option below.
filter.filters-empty-no-quick: There are no quick filters here: use “:custom” to filter on any field.
filter.filters-empty-search-by: To search a single field, type your text, then pick that field under “:section”.
filter.grouped-action-checked-rows-only: This action applies to the checked rows only: check the rows to act on (not every match) and try again.
filter.grouped-action-not-allowed: You are not allowed to do this on these results.
filter.keyboard-hint: ↑ ↓ ← → to move · Enter to open · Esc to close
filter.name: Name
filter.no-custom-rules: No filters yet. Add one with "New filter".
filter.no-custom-rules-hint: Each filter is a field, an operator and a value; the results match all of them. Filters also show as pills: click one to edit it.
filter.nothing-deleted-not-allowed: Nothing was deleted: you are not allowed to delete some of the selected items.
filter.nothing-to-delete: None of the selected items can be deleted.
filter.pick-entity-hint: Choose what to search: its filters appear here. The numbers count the matches of the typed text.
filter.relation-search-min-chars: Type at least :min characters to search
filter.reset-filter-hint: Remove every filter and the search text: back to this table's default filters
filter.share-unavailable: This view can't be shared from this page.
filter.share-view-hint: Anyone signed in who opens this link gets a copy of these filters and this search. Your later changes don't change the link. A link unused for :days days expires.
filter.show-filters: Show the search and its filters
filter.too-many-items-selected: Too many items selected: select at most :max at a time.
filter.type-then-pick: Type a value in the search box, then pick the field it filters.
filter.with-values-not-deletable-count: :count selected item(s) can't be deleted and will be left as they are.
navbar.no-results-hint: Try another spelling or remove a filter.
navbar.search.type-min-chars: Type a word of at least :min letters or digits to see results.
